## What forecasters project

Each forecaster’s central projection for Russia, alongside earlier UN revisions. The newest vintage from each forecaster is shown; older revisions are in the legend.

## Population: forecasters and earlier UN revisions

UN 2024 Census 2025 IHME 2020 UN 2022 WIC 2023

UN revisions from 1998 to 2019 publish fertility as five-year period averages (e.g. 2045–2050), with no single-year value; their paths are in the chart above. Wittgenstein Centre values are five-year period averages shown at the period's first year (2050 = 2050–2055).

Sources, licenses, and attribution for every forecaster are listed in the methodology.

Data sourced from UN World Population Prospects, World Bank World Development Indicators, and the Human Mortality Database. See docs for citation guidance.
